blurb: Guests make a tandem skydive from 14,000 feet, freefalling for about 45 seconds before parachuting to a soft landing. Training and ground preparation take 30 minutes to an hour, and guests are harnessed to a professional instructor. The operation is reservation-only and open March through November.
extraNote: Reservation required; $100 deposit per person charged if cancelled less than 72 hours before jump · No charge if cancelled with at least 72 hours notice · Payment expected by cash or check at airport; credit card payment accepted in advance via PayPal · Open by appointment only, closed during winter · Hurricane Airport, 800 West 2300 South, Hurricane, UT 84737 · March - November
